params.question: at fixed useful workload, does increasing UNUSED request capacity increase user-space cost?

hypotheses.H1-TP: ThreadPool cost rises with C via resolve_completion O(request_capacity) per await
hypotheses.H1-URING: Uring cost rises more strongly via BOTH resolve_completion O(C) and find_live_router_cookie_ O(C) per CQE

params.counter_scope: process-aggregate user-mode counters over a 1-rep process (startup+build+teardown included, identical across cells, amortized per op; never subtracted)

execution_order.generator: random.Random(seed).sample(capacities) per round — generated before measurement

note: OFFICIAL EXP-0 btrfs CONTROL: URING (real liburing 2.14), /home btrfs SATA SSD (page-cache-warm; not cold-device I/O), D=8 Q=8, frozen design @77063e5 (PR #253)
